text: 🎬 Dono shapes ka scene match nahi kar raha, poora climax alag reel se hai.
🎬 (3,4) aur (5,2) - inki toh kabhi shaadi hi tay nahi thi bhai.
🎬 Dimensions ka poora natak chal raha hai, bas ek reshape kar de.
🎬 Wrong train pakad li tune, station hi alag hai - shapes match nahi.
🎬 Ye shapes ek doosre ko dekh ke bhi pehchaan nahi rahe.
🎭 Float aur int ek doosre ka role play kar rahe the, drama ho gaya.
🎭 Dtype ka juice hi alag nikal raha hai - cast kar warna crash pakka.
🎭 Guessing games band kar, dtype explicitly bata.
🎭 Int ko float samajh liya tune, ab confusion hi confusion hai.
🚌 Ek tensor CPU mein baitha hai, doosra kahin aur - same bus mein aa jao dono.
🚌 Signal hi match nahi ho raha, saare tensors ek device pe le aa.
🚌 Tensor ka saman galat station pe utar gaya bhai.
🚌 Connection hi nahi ban raha, device shift kar.
🚦 Gradient signal pe hi ruk gaya, requires_grad check kar le.
🚦 Graph ka ek piece missing hai, isiliye gradient kahin nahi pahuncha.
🚦 Backward call kiya par gradient ne reply hi nahi diya.
🚦 Dhoondh raha hoon gradient ko, mil hi nahi raha - graph tut gaya lagta hai.
👻 NaN ne poori training ko haunt kar diya bhai.
👻 Numbers overflow ho ke seedha NaN ke samundar mein doob gaye.
👻 Loss NaN ho gaya, gubbara phat gaya samjho.
👻 Model ko chakkar aa gaya, output NaN de raha hai.
📦 RAM mein jagah hi nahi bachi, ghar khali kar.
📦 Bag itna bhar diya ki zip hi nahi lag rahi - batch size kam kar.
📦 Memory ne darwaza band kar diya bhai, andar jagah nahi.
📦 Ek aur tensor daala aur deewar gir gayi - OOM ho gaya.
🏁 Poora safar ho gaya, ab result ka samay hai.
🏁 The End - lekin sequel (agla training run) toh aana hi hai.
🏁 Training wrap ho gaya, ab bas fingers crossed for accuracy.
🏁 Pura movie khatam, ab review ka time.
🔁 Ek aur round ho gaya, agla load kar.
🔁 Epoch ka ek chapter khatam, agla open kar.
🔁 Ek target aur clear, chalo aage badhte hain.
🔁 Ek seedhi aur chadh li, upar dekhte rehna.
📚 Model tota ban gaya, bas rata maar raha hai, samajh kuch nahi raha.
📚 Poori kitaab yaad kar li, exam mein naya sawaal aaya toh phas gaya.
📚 Training data pe perfect acting, real duniya mein flop show.
📚 Dimag mein sirf training data ghus gaya, baaki sab bahar.
🐌 Model itni slow speed se seekh raha hai, dono jagah fail ho raha.
🐌 Half-cooked model hai ye, na training pe pakka na validation pe.
🐌 Model abhi tak so hi raha hai, kuch seekha hi nahi.
🐌 Model freeze ho gaya lagta hai, movement hi nahi dikh raha seekhne mein.
🛑 Time pe brake laga di, aage overfitting ka signal tha.
🛑 Bhaagte bhaagte ruk gaye, sahi mauke pe sahi decision.
🛑 Bas yahi tak, aage ka rasta overfitting ki taraf jaa raha tha.
🛑 Cut! Yahi best take tha, aage retakes bekar the.
🔒 Progress lock ho gaya, ab crash bhi ho toh gham nahi.
🔒 Yahan tak ka safar pin ho gaya, restart se dar nahi lagta ab.
🔒 Game save ho gaya, agla level try karne ka himmat aa gayi.
🔒 Safety pin lag gaya, ab kuch bhi ho jaaye.
⚙ Optimizer ke settings mein hi locha hai, hyperparameters dobara check kar.
⚙ Sab knobs galat jagah set kar diye, optimizer confuse ho gaya.
⚙ Hisaab hi galat laga diya optimizer ne - config check kar bhai.
⚙ Optimizer start hi nahi ho raha, kuch toh missing hai setup mein.
💯 Bilkul sahi chala, ekdum on point.
💯 Kaam ban gaya bhai, full satisfaction.
💯 Seedha target pe laga, koi issue nahi.
💯 Sab kuch smooth chala, tension free.
🚨 Kuch to gadbad hai, aage badhne se pehle check kar le.
🚨 Ye scene thoda suspicious lag raha hai, dhyan se dekh.
🚨 Kuch missing lag raha hai yahan, ek baar aur nazar daal.
🚨 Signal thoda off lag raha hai, aage badhne se pehle ruk ja.
